Callouts

Note: When the array is stopped, libraries show No access, and nothing in them is treated as deleted.

Warning: Keep Maktaba’s data folder on a pool or a single disk, never on the array’s /mnt/user share. Its database would be slow and could be damaged there.

Tip: Set Container Path to the same path as Host Path. Machines that join this home later then find the same share.

Code and compose blocks

In the container’s Console
/opt/maktaba/server/bin/maktaba-server container setup

After a press: the label reads Copied for two seconds, and a screen reader hears it.

In the container’s Console
/opt/maktaba/server/bin/maktaba-server container setup
The compose file: docker-compose.yml
services:
  maktaba:
    image: ghcr.io/hamza-labs-core/maktaba-server:latest
    container_name: maktaba
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "1000:1000"
    stop_grace_period: 90s
    environment:
      MAKTABA_PLATFORM: docker
      TZ: Asia/Riyadh
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - maktaba:/var/lib/maktaba
      - /srv/media:/srv/media
volumes:
  maktaba:

The step list

  1. Find Maktaba in Apps

    Apps → search Maktaba → Install.

  2. Fill in the template

    Keep /mnt/cache/appdata/maktaba for the data, and add your media share.

  3. Run the setup

    Docker → Maktaba’s icon → Console, and run:

    In the container’s Console
    /opt/maktaba/server/bin/maktaba-server container setup

Mixed scripts in one line

On an Arabic page, a Latin run is isolated, so its punctuation stays with it:

Open الإعدادات ← التحديثات on an Arabic screen, or run docker compose up -d in the terminal.

Maktaba

Maktaba keeps a household’s films and series on its own computer and plays them on every screen at home. Free and open source, under the MIT licence.
